help.title: मदद
help.intro: TODO-translate: Questions about a booking or a machine? Talk to a person.
help.hours: TODO-translate: Every day, 7 am to 8 pm.
help.q1: TODO-translate: How do I book a machine?
help.a1: TODO-translate: Pick the job, your village and your dates, then choose a machine and send the request. The owner has 2 hours to say yes. Your booking code, like KR-1234, appears in My bookings.
help.a2: TODO-translate: In the last step of booking you choose UPI, card, net banking or pay after the work. The deposit is shown separately and is not part of what you pay.
help.a3: TODO-translate: Open the booking in My bookings and tap Cancel. It is free until 24 hours before the start time.
help.q4: TODO-translate: What if the machine breaks down?
help.a4: TODO-translate: Call the owner from the booking page, then tap Report a problem so we know. We read every report.
help.q5: TODO-translate: How do I list my machine?
help.a5: TODO-translate: Go to Settings, turn on I list machines, then add your machine with its price, place and photos. Upload a photo of the RC (registration certificate) too; we check it.
help.a6: TODO-translate: This is a demo; no real money moves.
help.reportBody: TODO-translate: Something wrong with a booking? Open it from My bookings and tap Report a problem.
help.placeholder: TODO-translate: Support numbers are not set yet.

price.title: हम कीमत कैसे तय करते हैं
price.lead: TODO-translate: You see the full price before you ask for a machine. There are no extras at the end.
price.formula: TODO-translate: Your price = the owner's rate + diesel (if it is not included). The deposit comes back after the job.
price.exIntro: TODO-translate: A {hp} HP tractor at {rate} for {hours} hours, diesel included:
price.deposit: TODO-translate: Deposit (comes back after the job)
price.depositTitle: TODO-translate: How the deposit is set
price.deposit1: TODO-translate: For a job under 8 hours the deposit is 25% of the rent, but never more than a fixed amount for that kind of machine.
price.deposit2: TODO-translate: For a longer job it is 15% of the rent, or the fixed amount, whichever is higher.
price.deposit3: TODO-translate: The fixed amounts start at ₹500 for a sprayer and ₹1,950 for a small tractor, and go up to ₹12,500 for a combine harvester. All amounts are whole rupees.
price.fee: TODO-translate: We take 13.5% of the rent. It comes out of the owner's share and is never added to your bill.
price.feeEx: TODO-translate: On {rent} of rent the owner keeps {keep}.
price.ratesTitle: TODO-translate: How owners set the rate
price.rates: TODO-translate: Each owner sets one rate per hour, per acre or per day. We show owners what similar machines nearby charge, and they decide.
price.cancel: TODO-translate: Cancel for free until 24 hours before the start. After that, cancelling may cost the deposit.
price.sourcesIntro: TODO-translate: The numbers on our welcome page come from these.
price.src1: TODO-translate: Agriculture Census 2015–16 (Government of India): 86.21% of farm holdings are small or marginal, under 2 hectares.
price.src2: TODO-translate: Agriculture Census 2015–16: the average operational holding is 1.08 hectares.
price.src3: TODO-translate: Reports in 2025 put India's farm mechanisation at about 47%, against about 95% in the United States.
price.srcNote: TODO-translate: If newer census figures are published, we update the page.

s1.p: TODO-translate: Your name, mobile number or email, and the places and dates you search or book. Owners also upload photos of their machine and its RC.

s2.p: TODO-translate: Your mobile number, email and location are used only for bookings: to find machines near you, to show the owner who is asking, and to send you updates.
